description: Membership evaluation (§5.1). Each case lists op records {id, identity, op, par}; records whose op does not parse are dropped (like sharing.ts) before evaluate(). `devices` maps device → identity for cut-off lifting. `writes` are mayWrite(identity, device, seq) and `manage` mayManage(identity) under the result.

cases.name: create only
create: wrong nonce for the space id
create: signed by someone other than the owner
create: with parents
add: owner adds any role, admin adds writer/reader only
add: an existing member cannot be added again
add: needs the author to be in the state of its ancestors
role: demote with a cut-off, admin may not touch admins
role: promoting back to writer lifts the cut-off
remove: cut-off applies, the owner cannot be removed
remove: admin cannot remove an admin
remove wins over a concurrent role change
a re-add that has seen only one of two removals is overridden by the other
re-add after every removal
concurrent removals combine cut-offs to the minimum
leave: members may leave, the owner may not
transfer: old owner becomes admin; only the owner, only to a member
revoke: any member relays a valid revocation
revoke: a forged revocation is not an op
missing parents and cycles are not evaluated
a writer that was never removed has no cut-off
